changelog:
- YouTube Shorts: Smooth single-tap play/pause without description drawer popping or looping stutter.
- Smart Minimizing: PiP mode strictly restricted to active playing videos, never minimizing on home or idle pages.
- Background Media Playback: Audio and video continue playing in background, with dedicated settings toggle.
- Login & 2FA Fix: Resolved blank screen on x.com and OAuth by implementing onCloseWindow and allowing auth cookies.
- Command Bar Polish: Removed 0.3s white flash on scrolling to top with instant dark docking.
- Fokk AI Summary: Pristine editorial article extraction filtering nav junk, source logo, accurate reading time, background notification, and Saved Summaries archive.
